messages:
jasmin: Quick PSA: found an almost-empty kombucha keg in the fridge with a Post-it 'do not drink' but no name. Smells a bit vinegary. :grimacing:
leo: Not mine. Could be from last Friday's demo snack table. If it's that old, toss it.
ravi: I nominate it for science first. ; ) but seriously, toss if no owner by EOD. I'll bring a 2L kombucha replacement tomorrow if y'all want.
anya: Ooh yes please! Also note the toaster is set on 5 now and my bagel emerged charcoal yesterday. Can someone reset to 3? There's a tiny sticker on the back for settings but it's faded.
jasmin: Good call. I put a sticky note on the toaster marked "3 = bagels, 2 = english muffins" and took a photo: https://imgur.com/office-toaster (just kidding, photo attached in thread).
sam: Quick dietary heads-up: we got a request for nut-free snacks in the open area (kid visiting). I'm happy to buy a nut-free granola if people are okay.
leo: Nut-free granola yes please. Also can we standardize cereal bowls? There's a rogue ramen bowl in the cupboard that keeps terrifying people.
ravi: I'll declutter the cupboard after lunch and move mismatched bowls to the "donate" bin by the mailroom.
anya: Also re: coffee beans 17 roast preference poll? Light/medium/dark. My vote: medium.
jasmin: Medium for me too. Let's do medium for the next bag and rotate.
kitchen-bot: Poll created: "Next coffee roast?" options: Light, Medium, Dark. Poll ends 1977660000.
leo: Can someone bring extra oat milk Friday? We're low. I'll cover costs.
ravi: I have a half carton in my bag; leaving it in the office fridge now. Labelled "ravi - 03/25".
jasmin: Tiny request: if you microwave fish please use vented container and put a paper towel under. We had a smell emergency on Monday. :mask:
anya: Agreed. Also adding "no uncovered dishes" to the pinned kitchen rules.
sam: Thank you for taking the bowl from my desk, ravi. :heart:
jasmin: No problem. Final note: I'll run a "kitchen tidy sprint" at 4:30 today for 15 minutes if anyone wants to join. Free cookies as incentive.
leo: Count me in. Cookies > chores.
kitchen-bot: Reminder: "Kitchen tidy sprint" 16:30 today. Cookie stash location: top shelf labeled "treats".
